answer: A $40 onyx seal bonds every verified social edge. Influence is counted in marble: one edge earns a single marble, and no island pushes more than 12 marble through one cut per epoch. Edges are earned one by one, each sealed before it counts. Auditors from other clusters spot-check 5% of edges each epoch; a fake edge forfeits its seal and every marble its island held. Forging 100 clones burns $4,000 yet moves only 12 marble, $333 each, while an honest agent spends $120 for 3 marble at $40 each. It behaves like a harbor channel. Twelve boats pass however many dinghies crowd the bay.
